independent_statistical_recomputation.difference_convention: first method minus comparator; lower validation loss is better
independent_statistical_recomputation.interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval over three paired seeds

paper_ready_conclusions: Moonlight is strong at LLaMA-124M but does not preserve that ranking at LLaMA-1B as training extends.
At LLaMA-1B, global diagonal beats local diagonal, identity, and full-K routes in all 27 paired seed-budget comparisons.
Muon beats global diagonal in all nine paired LLaMA-1B comparisons, with mean gaps inside the descriptive +/-0.002 practical band at each budget; this is not a formal equivalence claim.
The accepted evidence supports environment- and training-stage-conditioned state allocation rather than a universal route ranking.
